current_queue_schema_audit.conclusion: The JSON container is schemaless enough to hold new top-level data, but the current supported queue schema/monitor contract lacks a durable, versioned reviewed-provenance block for the full repaired evidence chain.

details.queue_load: json object fields are retained in memory.
details.serialization: atomic_json serializes the full object, so a dedicated unknown top-level review_provenance block survives a pure load/serialize round-trip.
details.existing_candidate_merge: add_candidates updates selected fields on existing records; it does not reconstruct the whole record.
details.matching_refresh: apply_matching_result changes matching fields only; however a material/stale match triggers reclassification.
details.reclassification: apply_classification_decision replaces classification_reason_codes, classification_evidence and review_note. Therefore repaired evidence stored only in classification_evidence or review_note is not durable.
details.composition: apply_episode_composition writes top-level composition_provenance and an episode_level_composition copy into classification_evidence, but stored composition_provenance is not a classification input.
details.deduplication: No safe reviewed-provenance merge contract exists; identity dedup does not by itself consume or validate reviewed provenance.

monitor_persistence_audit.conclusion: A dedicated top-level provenance block could be physically preserved, but the currently used evidence/review fields are not safe persistence locations across reclassification, and persistence alone would not solve consumption.

classifier_inputs: current tracked episodes and publication-time matching
monitor_provenance_consumption_audit.conclusion: A dedicated unknown top-level reviewed-provenance block can survive JSON serialization and non-reconstructive queue updates, but current classification/reclassification/composition logic does not consume it. Reclassification also replaces classification_evidence and review_note, so machine-critical repaired provenance cannot safely live only in those fields.

authoritative_replay_confirmation.adapter_description: The replay projects repaired evidence into the same decision concepts used by current classification_evidence / temporal_binding / same_attack_context / episode composition. It does not write those fields to live queue records.

monitor_provenance_consumption_audit.critical_finding: classify_candidate and compose_episode_candidates re-derive evidence from candidate text/source/publication metadata and tracked episodes. They do not merge or consume finalized structured reviewed provenance from queue records.

representative_future_run_simulation.method: Read-only in-memory persistence/consumption simulation anchored to the authoritative current-code system-wide replay. The authoritative no-adapter replay result is used for the current-code classification outcome; direct code audit proves the injected block is not consumed.
